newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton markets close for New Year holidays.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton markets close for New Year holidays.

text.p: Indian cotton markets were closed for the second successive day on Tuesday for Hindu New Year holidays, dealers said.
On Friday, cotton prices gained on renewed interest from mill owners as farmers went on holiday ahead of the weekend's Diwali festival, dealers said
In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by 10 rupees to 930/960 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned rose by 25 rupees to 1,625/1,750 rupees.
